fusions.name: Snapped Branch
fusions.desc: Snaps off a lock grown hard and jagged, at a cost of 4% of your maximum health, and throws it at a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 9 slashing damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stinging Bloom
fusions.desc: Every strand opens into a stinging polyp and fires at once, dealing 12 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Polyp Garden
fusions.desc: Your hair roots where you stand and spreads into a bed of polyps reaching 3 tiles around you. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Accreted Shell
fusions.desc: When you are healed, the new growth along your hair hardens into a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
